research.title: Classifier Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine how controlled changes in feature distributions affect classifier calibration on tabular datasets.
Compared temperature scaling and isotonic regression using held-out calibration sets, documenting reliability diagrams and sensitivity to calibration sample selection.

work.title: Batch Data Import Validation
bullets: Implemented validation checks for batch imports, handling missing fields, inconsistent data types, and duplicate records within an existing processing pipeline.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and documented error handling behavior to support maintenance of existing data import components.

projects.title: Regularized Regression With Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized predictors and cross-validation for selecting regularization settings on tabular prediction tasks.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature configurations, keeping preprocessing and evaluation splits consistent between methods.

projects.title: Missing-Data Strategies for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented mean imputation and nearest-neighbor imputation before logistic regression, fitting preprocessing steps exclusively on training data to prevent leakage.
Compared classification performance under random and feature-dependent missingness, examining how missingness patterns affected predictions and the usefulness of missing-value indicators.

projects.title: Prediction Intervals for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented split conformal prediction around linear and random forest regressors, using separate training, calibration, and test partitions.
Compared interval coverage and width across nonlinear datasets with varying noise patterns, inspecting conditional coverage across regions of the feature space.
